title: The watch tests read a run through to the line after its verdict
description: The watch tests read a run through to the line after its verdict
no_spec_change_rationale: A test-only fix: watch_until stopped at the first verdict marker, so a later line of the same run, such as a contradicting warning, was never in the output the watch tests judge. No spec or requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: watch_until stops only once a verdict marker is followed by the line watch prints after each run (Watching for changes in: after the first, Watching for changes... after later ones); a unit test on sample output fails on the verdict alone and passes with the line after it (red then green)
